correctness.rationale: With t=(x/lambda)^k, f(x)dx=e^-t dt and for positive integer m, P(m,z)=1-e^-z sum_{j=0}^{m-1}z^j/j!. Thus printed 2^m f(x)P(m,t/2) integrates 2^m/3^m; symbolic exact integration independently verified m=2,3,5. General current-record density Eq. (2.10) yields 2^m f(x)P(m,t). Differentiation of G=P(m,2t)-2^m e^-t P(m,t) gives 2^m e^-t P(m,t), G(0)=0 and G(infinity)=1; symbolic residual zero. Restrict correction to marginal upper record equations and downstream results actually depending on them.
